groups.rationale: Reviewed the trunk 7ae64792 merge into feat/mila: trunk's per-feature localization partition, ADR-0207 bundled fonts and Antithesis trace-sequence fix combine with Mila, Susan and Notifications without changing system ownership, domains or topology.

Reviewed the trunk merge: Mila's SSH approval 'Open Mila' link and documentation strings now live in trunk's ssh and documentation gettext domains with every locale filled, including arz, ha and sw; chapter 08 records Mila's per-locale catalogs and framework fallback, and chapter 19 adds the mila-localized-surfaces scenario.
Reviewed the trunk merge: protocol command catalog, AppRoute, PushPoke and SusanPoke are unchanged by the merge; trunk's protocol edits do not touch the Mila commands or fixtures.
Reviewed the trunk merge: trunk's guest display relay and Lilly changes are independent of Mila and Susan; no Lilly behaviour changes in the merge resolution.

Reviewed the trunk merge: Porsche's Mila command refusals moved into trunk's help and management gettext domains with arz, ha and sw translations; chapter 08 records Mila's locale handling and chapter 19 its localization scenario. Susan is unchanged.
Reviewed the trunk merge: Nix registrations for Mila, Susan and the push machine tests are kept alongside trunk's; deployment topology, secrets and options are unchanged by the resolution.

Reviewed the trunk merge: architecture and review indexes are unions with trunk's ADR-0207 and localization entries; ADR-0222 now refers to every Porsche locale catalog by feature domain instead of a fixed count; chapter 19 gains the Mila localization scenario.
